arc.fallback: Great Sea Battle of Kirigakure Arc

description.fallback: [Anime-only side story] At night, Isari sails to Kirigakure with a fleet. A governor allied with him comments on their partnership before going inside. Isari and his subordinate Jibiki dislike the quiet ocean, and wish for it be a raging ocean.
